status: reviewed against exact pinned source; native scenario pending
findings: fund_CJ maps CtrlF to forward character, CtrlW to killregion, and CtrlY to yank.
killregion computes the marked region, moves point to its start, deletes the region into the kill buffer, and clears mark.
yank inserts the kill buffer at the current point.
Contract moves from line start across "alpha " (6 chars), sets mark, advances over "beta" (4 chars), cuts those four bytes, moves to end of line, and yanks the word.
safety: synthetic disposable notes.txt only; mg runs with -S -n under managed workspace
